Name: Passive Messages
Author: emurphy42
Description:
This mod looks for tiles that would display a message at the bottom of the screen if you interacted with them, and sends those same messages to the chat window as you walk by.[list]
[*]Includes config option for scan radius (default 1, i.e. same coverage area as a quality sprinkler).
[*]Once a message has been sent to the chat window, it won't be sent again unless you leave the location and come back.
[*][url=https://github.com/emurphy42/PassiveMessages]Source code[/url]﻿

[/list]

Manifest.Name: Passive Messages
Manifest.Description: Display messages attached to tiles just by walking near them.
